items.title: Spiral Rosebud Vine DXF Panel for Laser-Cut Wall Art
items.description: A single vine climbs the panel's edge, sprouting spiral rosebuds, curling tendrils, and pointed leaves along its length. Compared to other vine designs in this collection, the spiral rosebud motif here is more compact and evenly spaced, giving the piece a tidier, more structured rhythm.
